diagnosis: The theorem body was only `skip`. The repair proves the diamond property by induction on the first parallel reduction, analyzing the second reduction and resolving primitive-redex/application overlaps with the supplied irreducibility lemmas.
proof_body:
by
  intro a b c hab hac
  induction hab generalizing c with
  | refl =>
      exact ⟨c, hac, .refl c⟩
  | red_I =>
      cases hac with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
      | red_I =>
          exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
      | par i' a' hi ha =>
          have hi' : i' = I := I_irreducible i' hi
          subst i'
          exact ⟨a', ha, .red_I a'⟩
  | red_K _ =>
      cases hac with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
      | red_K =>
          exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
      | par k' b' hk hb =>
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hk'⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ k' hk
          subst k'
          exact ⟨x, hx, .red_K x b'⟩
  | red_S _ _ _ =>
      cases hac with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
      | red_S =>
          exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
      | par s' c' hs hc =>
          obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hs'⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ s' hs
          subst s'
          exact
            ⟨x ⬝ c' ⬝ (y ⬝ c'),
              .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc),
              .red_S x y c'⟩
  | par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb =>
      cases hac with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨a' ⬝ b', .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
      | red_I =>
          have ha' : a' = I := I_irreducible a' ha
          subst a'
          exact ⟨b', .red_I b', hb⟩
      | red_K =>
          obtain ⟨x, hx, ha'⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ a' ha
          subst a'
          exact ⟨x, .red_K x b', hx⟩
      | red_S _ _ =>
          obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, ha'⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ a' ha
          subst a'
          exact
            ⟨x ⬝ b' ⬝ (y ⬝ b'),
              .red_S x y b',
              .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
      | par c' d' hc hd =>
          obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := iha hc
          obtain ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := ihb hd
          exact ⟨x ⬝ y, .par hx₁ hy₁, .par hx₂ hy₂⟩
